owning_project: Project 03 — A PRASA Business, Brand & Administration
purpose: Independent completeness witness for the canonical Training corpus. This file is the expected record set; data/training-opportunities.json is the candidate. They are compared against each other, so neither can shrink on its own.
why_this_exists: Deriving the expected record set from the candidate data file, or from the marker regions on index.html / pt/index.html, cannot detect a COORDINATED deletion: remove a record from the data file AND its marker regions from both Home surfaces and every derived expectation shrinks with it, so the structured-data validator, both generator drift checks and the generator ownership tests all still pass while a governed record has silently left the site.

This manifest does not shrink by itself. Removing, adding or renaming a governed record requires editing this file in the same commit, which is the point: the change becomes explicit and reviewable instead of invisible.

It is an IDENTITY and ORDER witness only. It carries no copy, no lifecycle state and no currentness rule — publication_state and expiry stay entirely in the canonical data file and the incumbent lifecycle system. A record moving CURRENT -> EXPIRED is not a corpus change and must not require touching this file.
maintenance: When Project 03 adds, retires or renames a canonical training record, update record_ids in the same commit as data/training-opportunities.json. Order is the governed published Home order and is compared exactly.
